rows.caption:
Making her Island Jazz debut, this Thursday singer Nadine Haddad takes the stage joined by Coby Nabuurs on piano, Isaac Williams on bass, and Joe Bezanson on drums.  Formed in the summer of 2026, the quartet is a new addition to PEI's jazz scene, performing a mix of jazz standards, swing, bossa nova, and contemporary favourites. 

A classically trained vocalist with a background in musical theatre and jazz, Nadine brings her love of storytelling and diverse musical influences to the stage. Drawing inspiration from artists such as Ella Fitzgerald, Julie London, Chet Baker, Olivia Dean and Laufey, the quartet explores everything from swinging classics and soulful ballads to modern favourites with a jazz influence. With plenty of room for improvisation and musical spontaneity, the group puts its own spin on familiar tunes while celebrating the jazz traditions that inspire them.

Two sets starting a little after 8pm. $10 minimum at the door. Island Jazz at Baba's Lounge every Thursday night all year round.

rows.caption:
Raine Maida and Chantal Kreviazuk are bringing their I'M GOING TO BREAK YOUR HEART tour to the Sobey Family Theatre! 

➡️ https://confederationcentre.com/event/raine-and-chantal/
 November 4, 8 p.m.

With a combined 30 nominations, 8 Juno awards and a Grammy, Raine Maida (Our Lady Peace) and Chantal Kreviazuk have spent three decades shaping the sound of contemporary music both separately and together. Their partnership extends well past music. They have received multiple humanitarian awards for their work with Warchild and Mental Health and are Order of Canada recipients.

As one of Canada’s most influential couples, Maida and Kreviazuk are stepping into a bold new chapter which includes a forthcoming double memoir due out August 5th, a new album together and an exciting fall tour. Their show defies usual concert experiences. Extraordinary musical performances alongside unscripted moments between songs that only a couple who have truly lived and created together could offer. It’s a night that moves you, surprises you and stays with you long after the lights come up.
